question_en: Which matrices are Hermitian? 1) $\begin{pmatrix}1&i\\-i&2\end{pmatrix}$; 2) $\begin{pmatrix}0&i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$; 3) $\begin{pmatrix}2&1+i\\1+i&3\end{pmatrix}$; 4) $\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
question_uz: Qaysi matritsalar Ermit? 1) $\begin{pmatrix}1&i\\-i&2\end{pmatrix}$; 2) $\begin{pmatrix}0&i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$; 3) $\begin{pmatrix}2&1+i\\1+i&3\end{pmatrix}$; 4) $\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
question_ru: Какие матрицы эрмитовы? 1) $\begin{pmatrix}1&i\\-i&2\end{pmatrix}$; 2) $\begin{pmatrix}0&i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$; 3) $\begin{pmatrix}2&1+i\\1+i&3\end{pmatrix}$; 4) $\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. Ermit shart: A21 = A12*. 1 va 4 da bajariladi; 2 da i ≠ (i)*, 3 da 1+i ≠ (1+i)* = 1−i.
Asos: A† = A.

uz: Diagonalga simmetrik elementlar qo'shma bo'lishi kerak: $$1:\ -i=i^*;\quad 2:\ i\neq\left(i\right)^*;\quad 3:\ 1+i\neq1-i;\quad 4:\ i=\left(-i\right)^*$$
ru: Элементы, симметричные относительно диагонали, должны быть сопряжены: $$1:\ -i=i^*;\quad 2:\ i\neq\left(i\right)^*;\quad 3:\ 1+i\neq1-i;\quad 4:\ i=\left(-i\right)^*$$
en: Elements symmetric about the diagonal must be conjugate: $$1:\ -i=i^*;\quad 2:\ i\neq\left(i\right)^*;\quad 3:\ 1+i\neq1-i;\quad 4:\ i=\left(-i\right)^*$$

question_en: What are the eigenvalues of the matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$?
question_uz: Matritsa $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$ ning xos qiymatlari qaysilar?
question_ru: Каковы собственные значения матрицы $\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\2&1\end{pmatrix}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. Iz 2, determinant 1 − 4 = −3; yig'indisi 2, ko'paytmasi −3 bo'lgan sonlar 3 va −1.
Asos: iz va determinant.

uz: Iz va determinant: $$\lambda_1+\lambda_2=2,\quad \lambda_1\lambda_2=1-4=-3\ \Rightarrow\ \lambda=3,\ -1$$
en: Trace and determinant: $$\lambda_1+\lambda_2=2,\quad \lambda_1\lambda_2=1-4=-3\ \Rightarrow\ \lambda=3,\ -1$$

question_en: The wave function is $\psi=Ax^2e^{-x/a}$ for $x\geq0$ and zero for $x<0$. What is the normalization constant $A$? $\int_0^{\infty}x^ne^{-x/c}dx=n!\,c^{n+1}$.
question_uz: To'lqin funksiyasi $x\geq0$ da $\psi=Ax^2e^{-x/a}$, $x<0$ da nol. Normallash konstantasi $A$ qanday? $\int_0^{\infty}x^ne^{-x/c}dx=n!\,c^{n+1}$.
question_ru: Волновая функция $\psi=Ax^2e^{-x/a}$ при $x\geq0$ и нуль при $x<0$. Какова нормировочная константа $A$? $\int_0^{\infty}x^ne^{-x/c}dx=n!\,c^{n+1}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. ∫x⁴·exp(−2x/a)dx = 4!·(a/2)⁵ = 3a⁵/4; A² = 4/(3a⁵), A = 2/(√3·a²·√a).
Asos: normallash sharti.

uz: $\left|\psi\right|^2=A^2x^4e^{-2x/a}$, $c=\frac{a}{2}$, $n=4$: $$A^2\cdot4!\left(\frac{a}{2}\right)^5=A^2\frac{3a^5}{4}=1\ \Rightarrow\ A=\frac{2}{\sqrt3\,a^{5/2}}$$
en: $\left|\psi\right|^2=A^2x^4e^{-2x/a}$, $c=\frac{a}{2}$, $n=4$: $$A^2\cdot4!\left(\frac{a}{2}\right)^5=A^2\frac{3a^5}{4}=1\ \Rightarrow\ A=\frac{2}{\sqrt3\,a^{5/2}}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.2 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The probability density is $\left|\psi\right|^2\propto e^{-x^2/b^2}$. What is $\langle x^4\rangle$? Hint: differentiate $\int e^{-\alpha x^2}dx=\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{\alpha}}$ with respect to $\alpha$.
question_uz: Ehtimollik zichligi $\left|\psi\right|^2\propto e^{-x^2/b^2}$. $\langle x^4\rangle$ nimaga teng? Ko'rsatma: $\int e^{-\alpha x^2}dx=\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{\alpha}}$ ni $\alpha$ bo'yicha differensiallang.
question_ru: Плотность вероятности $\left|\psi\right|^2\propto e^{-x^2/b^2}$. Чему равно $\langle x^4\rangle$? Указание: продифференцируйте $\int e^{-\alpha x^2}dx=\sqrt{\frac{\pi}{\alpha}}$ по $\alpha$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Ikki marta differensiallab ∫x⁴·exp(−αx²)dx = (3/4α²)√(π/α); ⟨x⁴⟩ = 3/(4α²) = 3b⁴/4.
Asos: Gauss integrali.

uz: Ikki marta $\alpha$ bo'yicha differensiallaymiz va normallaymiz, $\alpha=\frac{1}{b^2}$: $$\langle x^4\rangle=\frac{3}{4\alpha^2}=\frac{3b^4}{4}$$
en: Differentiate twice with respect to $\alpha$ and normalize, $\alpha=\frac{1}{b^2}$: $$\langle x^4\rangle=\frac{3}{4\alpha^2}=\frac{3b^4}{4}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.2 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: What is the commutator $\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$?
question_uz: Kommutator $\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равен коммутатор $\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Leybnits qoidasi: [x,p²] = [x,p]p + p[x,p] = 2iħp.
Asos: [x, p] = iħ.

uz: Leybnits qoidasi: $$\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]=\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]\hat p+\hat p\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]=2i\hbar\hat p$$
ru: Правило Лейбница: $$\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]=\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]\hat p+\hat p\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]=2i\hbar\hat p$$
en: The Leibniz rule: $$\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]=\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]\hat p+\hat p\left[\hat x,\hat p\right]=2i\hbar\hat p$$

rules.uz: Leybnits qoidasi: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$
rules.ru: Правило Лейбница: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$
rules.en: Leibniz rule: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.3 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A particle in the infinite well is in the state $\psi=\frac{1}{\sqrt6}\left(2\psi_1-i\psi_2+\psi_3\right)$, $E_n=n^2E_1$. What is the average energy $\langle E\rangle$?
question_uz: Cheksiz o'radagi zarra holati $\psi=\frac{1}{\sqrt6}\left(2\psi_1-i\psi_2+\psi_3\right)$, $E_n=n^2E_1$. O'rtacha energiya $\langle E\rangle$ qancha?
question_ru: Состояние частицы в бесконечной яме $\psi=\frac{1}{\sqrt6}\left(2\psi_1-i\psi_2+\psi_3\right)$, $E_n=n^2E_1$. Какова средняя энергия $\langle E\rangle$?

uz: Ehtimolliklar $\left|c_n\right|^2$ va o'rtacha: $$\langle E\rangle=\frac{4\cdot1+1\cdot4+1\cdot9}{6}E_1=\frac{17}{6}E_1$$
en: Probabilities $\left|c_n\right|^2$ and the average: $$\langle E\rangle=\frac{4\cdot1+1\cdot4+1\cdot9}{6}E_1=\frac{17}{6}E_1$$

distractors.D: energiya n ga proporsional deb olingan

question_en: The Fourier transform of $\psi_0\left(x\right)$ is $\phi_0\left(k\right)$. What is the Fourier transform of the shifted function $\psi\left(x\right)=\psi_0\left(x-x_0\right)$? ($\phi\left(k\right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int\psi e^{-ikx}dx$)
question_uz: $\psi_0\left(x\right)$ ning Furye obrazi $\phi_0\left(k\right)$. Siljigan funksiya $\psi\left(x\right)=\psi_0\left(x-x_0\right)$ ning Furye obrazi qanday? ($\phi\left(k\right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int\psi e^{-ikx}dx$)
question_ru: Образ Фурье функции $\psi_0\left(x\right)$ равен $\phi_0\left(k\right)$. Каков образ Фурье сдвинутой функции $\psi\left(x\right)=\psi_0\left(x-x_0\right)$? ($\phi\left(k\right)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int\psi e^{-ikx}dx$)
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. u = x − x0 almashtirish: exp(−ikx) = exp(−ikx0)·exp(−iku). Siljish faza beradi, |φ|² o'zgarmaydi.
Asos: Furye almashtirishi.

uz: $u=x-x_0$ almashtirish: $$\phi=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int\psi_0\left(u\right)e^{-ik\left(u+x_0\right)}du=e^{-ikx_0}\phi_0\left(k\right)$$
en: The substitution $u=x-x_0$: $$\phi=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\int\psi_0\left(u\right)e^{-ik\left(u+x_0\right)}du=e^{-ikx_0}\phi_0\left(k\right)$$

question_en: What is $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\delta\left(2x-3\right)\left(x^2+1\right)dx$?
question_uz: $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\delta\left(2x-3\right)\left(x^2+1\right)dx$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Чему равен $\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\delta\left(2x-3\right)\left(x^2+1\right)dx$?

uz: Masshtab qoidasi va filtrlash: $$\delta\left(2x-3\right)=\frac{1}{2}\delta\left(x-\frac{3}{2}\right)\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{9}{4}+1\right)=\frac{13}{8}$$
en: The scaling rule and sifting: $$\delta\left(2x-3\right)=\frac{1}{2}\delta\left(x-\frac{3}{2}\right)\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{9}{4}+1\right)=\frac{13}{8}$$

question_en: A $2\times2$ Hermitian matrix has trace $5$ and determinant $6$. What are its eigenvalues?
question_uz: $2\times2$ Ermit matritsaning izi $5$, determinanti $6$. Uning xos qiymatlari qaysilar?
question_ru: След эрмитовой матрицы $2\times2$ равен $5$, определитель $6$. Каковы её собственные значения?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. λ² − 5λ + 6 = 0, λ = 2 va 3: yig'indi 5, ko'paytma 6.
Asos: λ1 + λ2 = tr A, λ1·λ2 = det A.

uz: Xarakteristik tenglama iz va determinant orqali: $$\lambda^2-5\lambda+6=0\ \Rightarrow\ \lambda=2,\ 3$$
ru: Характеристическое уравнение через след и определитель: $$\lambda^2-5\lambda+6=0\ \Rightarrow\ \lambda=2,\ 3$$
en: The characteristic equation via trace and determinant: $$\lambda^2-5\lambda+6=0\ \Rightarrow\ \lambda=2,\ 3$$

distractors.B: iz va determinant xos qiymat deb olingan

distractors_ru.B: след и определитель приняты за собств. значения

distractors_en.B: trace and determinant taken as eigenvalues

question_en: A spin state is $|\psi\rangle=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt3\\i\end{pmatrix}$. What is $\langle\sigma_y\rangle$? $\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
question_uz: Spin holati $|\psi\rangle=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt3\\i\end{pmatrix}$. $\langle\sigma_y\rangle$ qancha? $\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
question_ru: Спиновое состояние $|\psi\rangle=\frac{1}{2}\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt3\\i\end{pmatrix}$. Чему равно $\langle\sigma_y\rangle$? $\sigma_y=\begin{pmatrix}0&-i\\i&0\end{pmatrix}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. σy|ψ⟩ = (1, i√3)/2; ⟨ψ|σy|ψ⟩ = (√3·1 + (−i)(i√3))/4 = √3/2 — haqiqiy, chunki σy Ermit.
Asos: ⟨A⟩ = ⟨ψ|A|ψ⟩.

uz: $\sigma_y$ ni ta'sir ettiramiz va bra bilan ko'paytiramiz: $$\langle\sigma_y\rangle=\frac{1}{4}\left(\sqrt3\cdot1+\left(-i\right)\cdot i\sqrt3\right)=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$$
ru: Действуем $\sigma_y$ и умножаем на бра: $$\langle\sigma_y\rangle=\frac{1}{4}\left(\sqrt3\cdot1+\left(-i\right)\cdot i\sqrt3\right)=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$$
en: Apply $\sigma_y$ and multiply by the bra: $$\langle\sigma_y\rangle=\frac{1}{4}\left(\sqrt3\cdot1+\left(-i\right)\cdot i\sqrt3\right)=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.4 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: A particle in the infinite well is in its ground state. Approximately what is the probability of finding it in the middle third ($\frac{L}{3}<x<\frac{2L}{3}$)?
question_uz: Cheksiz o'radagi zarra asosiy holatda. Uni o'rta uchdan birda ($\frac{L}{3}<x<\frac{2L}{3}$) topish ehtimolligi taxminan qancha?
question_ru: Частица в бесконечной яме находится в основном состоянии. Какова примерно вероятность найти её в средней трети ($\frac{L}{3}<x<\frac{2L}{3}$)?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. P = (2/L)∫sin²(πx/L)dx = 1/3 + √3/(2π) ≈ 0.61 — klassik 1/3 dan katta, zarra markazda ko'proq.
Asos: P = ∫|ψ|²dx.

uz: Integral: $$P=\frac{2}{L}\int_{L/3}^{2L/3}\sin^2\frac{\pi x}{L}dx=\frac{1}{3}+\frac{\sqrt3}{2\pi}\approx0.61$$
en: The integral: $$P=\frac{2}{L}\int_{L/3}^{2L/3}\sin^2\frac{\pi x}{L}dx=\frac{1}{3}+\frac{\sqrt3}{2\pi}\approx0.61$$

source: OpenStax University Physics, 3-jild, 7-bob, 7.29 masalasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: For a free particle $\hat H=\frac{\hat p^2}{2m}$. What is the commutator $\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]$?
question_uz: Erkin zarra uchun $\hat H=\frac{\hat p^2}{2m}$. Kommutator $\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: Для свободной частицы $\hat H=\frac{\hat p^2}{2m}$. Чему равен коммутатор $\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. [p², x] = −[x, p²] = −2iħp; bo'lib: [H, x] = −iħp/m.
Asos: Leybnits qoidasi.

uz: $\left[\hat p^2,\hat x\right]=-\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$: $$\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]=\frac{1}{2m}\left(-2i\hbar\hat p\right)=-\frac{i\hbar}{m}\hat p$$
ru: $\left[\hat p^2,\hat x\right]=-\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$: $$\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]=\frac{1}{2m}\left(-2i\hbar\hat p\right)=-\frac{i\hbar}{m}\hat p$$
en: $\left[\hat p^2,\hat x\right]=-\left[\hat x,\hat p^2\right]$: $$\left[\hat H,\hat x\right]=\frac{1}{2m}\left(-2i\hbar\hat p\right)=-\frac{i\hbar}{m}\hat p$$

rules.uz: Leybnits qoidasi: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$
rules.ru: Правило Лейбница: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$
rules.en: Leibniz rule: $\left[\hat A,\hat B\hat C\right]=\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\hat C+\hat B\left[\hat A,\hat C\right]$

distractors.A: H va x kommutativ deb olingan

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.3 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan

question_en: The figure shows the probability density $\rho\left(x\right)$ of a particle on $0\leq x\leq L$ (a triangle with its peak at $x=\frac{L}{4}$). What is $\langle x\rangle$?
question_uz: Rasmda zarraning $0\leq x\leq L$ oraliqdagi ehtimollik zichligi $\rho\left(x\right)$ berilgan (uchburchak, cho'qqisi $x=\frac{L}{4}$ da). $\langle x\rangle$ nimaga teng?
question_ru: На рисунке дана плотность вероятности частицы $\rho\left(x\right)$ на отрезке $0\leq x\leq L$ (треугольник с вершиной при $x=\frac{L}{4}$). Чему равно $\langle x\rangle$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. Uchburchak zichlikning o'rtachasi uchlar abssissalarining o'rtachasi: (0 + L/4 + L)/3 = 5L/12.
Asos: ⟨x⟩ = ∫xρdx.

uz: Uchburchak taqsimotning o'rtachasi: $$\langle x\rangle=\frac{0+\frac{L}{4}+L}{3}=\frac{5L}{12}$$
en: The mean of a triangular distribution: $$\langle x\rangle=\frac{0+\frac{L}{4}+L}{3}=\frac{5L}{12}$$

question_en: The state is $|\psi\rangle=A\left[\left(1+i\right)|1\rangle+2|2\rangle+i|3\rangle\right]$ (the $|n\rangle$ are orthonormal). What is the probability of finding the system in $|2\rangle$?
question_uz: Holat $|\psi\rangle=A\left[\left(1+i\right)|1\rangle+2|2\rangle+i|3\rangle\right]$ ($|n\rangle$ — ortonormal). Sistemani $|2\rangle$ holatda topish ehtimolligi qancha?
question_ru: Состояние $|\psi\rangle=A\left[\left(1+i\right)|1\rangle+2|2\rangle+i|3\rangle\right]$ ($|n\rangle$ — ортонормированы). Какова вероятность найти систему в состоянии $|2\rangle$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. Norma kvadrati |1+i|² + 4 + |i|² = 2 + 4 + 1 = 7; P = 4/7.
Asos: P = |c|².

uz: Normallash va ehtimollik: $$\left|A\right|^2\left(2+4+1\right)=1,\qquad P_2=\frac{4}{7}$$
en: Normalization and probability: $$\left|A\right|^2\left(2+4+1\right)=1,\qquad P_2=\frac{4}{7}$$

question_en: A particle is in a superposition of two stationary states with $E_1=1.0\ \mathrm{eV}$ and $E_2=4.0\ \mathrm{eV}$. With what period does $\left|\Psi\left(x,t\right)\right|^2$ oscillate (in fs)? $h=4.14\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{eV\cdot s}$.
question_uz: Zarra ikki statsionar holat superpozitsiyasida: $E_1=1.0\ \mathrm{eV}$, $E_2=4.0\ \mathrm{eV}$. $\left|\Psi\left(x,t\right)\right|^2$ qanday davr bilan tebranadi (fs da)? $h=4.14\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{eV\cdot s}$.
question_ru: Частица в суперпозиции двух стационарных состояний: $E_1=1.0\ \mathrm{eV}$, $E_2=4.0\ \mathrm{eV}$. С каким периодом колеблется $\left|\Psi\left(x,t\right)\right|^2$ (в фс)? $h=4.14\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{eV\cdot s}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. Aralash had cos((E2 − E1)t/ħ) bilan tebranadi; T = h/(E2 − E1) = 4.14/3 ≈ 1.4 fs.
Asos: statsionar holat fazasi exp(−iEt/ħ).

uz: Aralash hadning chastotasi energiyalar farqi bilan aniqlanadi: $$T=\frac{h}{E_2-E_1}=\frac{4.14\cdot10^{-15}}{3.0}\approx1.4\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{s}$$
ru: Частота перекрёстного члена задаётся разностью энергий: $$T=\frac{h}{E_2-E_1}=\frac{4.14\cdot10^{-15}}{3.0}\approx1.4\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{s}$$
en: The frequency of the cross term is set by the energy difference: $$T=\frac{h}{E_2-E_1}=\frac{4.14\cdot10^{-15}}{3.0}\approx1.4\cdot10^{-15}\ \mathrm{s}$$

question_en: $\psi\left(x\right)$ is a real, even, normalized function. Which of the following integrals is **not** zero?
question_uz: $\psi\left(x\right)$ — haqiqiy, juft va normallangan funksiya. Quyidagi integrallardan qaysi biri nolga teng **emas**?
question_ru: $\psi\left(x\right)$ — действительная, чётная и нормированная функция. Какой из интегралов **не** равен нулю?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: B. x²ψ² juft va musbat; qolgan integrallar ostidagi funksiyalar toq (ψψ′ ham toq) — nolga teng.
Asos: toq funksiya integrali.

uz: Juftlikni tekshiramiz: $x$, $x^3$, $\psi'$, $x\cos x$ toq; $x^2$ juft: $$\int x^2\psi^2dx=\langle x^2\rangle>0$$
ru: Проверяем чётность: $x$, $x^3$, $\psi'$, $x\cos x$ нечётны; $x^2$ чётна: $$\int x^2\psi^2dx=\langle x^2\rangle>0$$
en: Check parity: $x$, $x^3$, $\psi'$, $x\cos x$ are odd; $x^2$ is even: $$\int x^2\psi^2dx=\langle x^2\rangle>0$$

question_en: $\hat A$ and $\hat B$ are non-commuting Hermitian operators. Which of the following is necessarily Hermitian?
question_uz: $\hat A$ va $\hat B$ — kommutatsiyalanmaydigan Ermit operatorlar. Quyidagilardan qaysi biri albatta Ermit?
question_ru: $\hat A$ и $\hat B$ — некоммутирующие эрмитовы операторы. Какой из операторов обязательно эрмитов?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: C. (AB)† = BA, demak [A,B]† = −[A,B] (anti-Ermit); i ko'paytuvchi uni Ermitga aylantiradi.
Asos: (AB)† = B†A†.

uz: Qo'shma olishda tartib almashadi: $$\left(i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\right)^\dagger=-i\left(\hat B\hat A-\hat A\hat B\right)=i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]$$
ru: При сопряжении порядок меняется: $$\left(i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\right)^\dagger=-i\left(\hat B\hat A-\hat A\hat B\right)=i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]$$
en: Conjugation reverses the order: $$\left(i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]\right)^\dagger=-i\left(\hat B\hat A-\hat A\hat B\right)=i\left[\hat A,\hat B\right]$$

question_en: An electron has kinetic energy $E_k=0.01\,m_ec^2$. By approximately what percentage does the non-relativistic formula $v=c\sqrt{\frac{2E_k}{mc^2}}$ overestimate the speed?
question_uz: Elektron kinetik energiyasi $E_k=0.01\,m_ec^2$. Norelyativistik formula $v=c\sqrt{\frac{2E_k}{mc^2}}$ tezlikni taxminan necha foiz oshirib ko'rsatadi?
question_ru: Кинетическая энергия электрона $E_k=0.01\,m_ec^2$. Примерно на сколько процентов нерелятивистская формула $v=c\sqrt{\frac{2E_k}{mc^2}}$ завышает скорость?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: A. ε = Ek/mc²; β² = 1 − 1/(1+ε)² ≈ 2ε − 3ε², β ≈ √(2ε)(1 − 3ε/4): ortiqcha 3ε/4 = 0.75 foiz.
Asos: binomial yoyish.

uz: $\varepsilon=\frac{E_k}{mc^2}$, $\gamma=1+\varepsilon$; binomial yoyish: $$\beta=\sqrt{1-\left(1+\varepsilon\right)^{-2}}\approx\sqrt{2\varepsilon}\left(1-\frac{3\varepsilon}{4}\right)\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{3}{4}\cdot0.01$$
en: $\varepsilon=\frac{E_k}{mc^2}$, $\gamma=1+\varepsilon$; binomial expansion: $$\beta=\sqrt{1-\left(1+\varepsilon\right)^{-2}}\approx\sqrt{2\varepsilon}\left(1-\frac{3\varepsilon}{4}\right)\ \Rightarrow\ \frac{3}{4}\cdot0.01$$

question_en: Which function is an eigenfunction of $\frac{d^2}{dx^2}$ but not of $\frac{d}{dx}$?
question_uz: Qaysi funksiya $\frac{d^2}{dx^2}$ ning xos funksiyasi, lekin $\frac{d}{dx}$ ning xos funksiyasi emas?
question_ru: Какая функция является собственной функцией $\frac{d^2}{dx^2}$, но не $\frac{d}{dx}$?
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: D. (cos kx)″ = −k²cos kx, lekin (cos kx)′ = −k sin kx ∝ cos kx emas. Bunday holatda kinetik energiya aniq, impuls aniq emas.
Asos: xos funksiya.

uz: Hosilalarni tekshiramiz: $$\frac{d^2}{dx^2}\cos kx=-k^2\cos kx,\qquad \frac{d}{dx}\cos kx=-k\sin kx$$
ru: Проверяем производные: $$\frac{d^2}{dx^2}\cos kx=-k^2\cos kx,\qquad \frac{d}{dx}\cos kx=-k\sin kx$$
en: Check the derivatives: $$\frac{d^2}{dx^2}\cos kx=-k^2\cos kx,\qquad \frac{d}{dx}\cos kx=-k\sin kx$$

question_en: An electron wave packet has width $\sigma_x=0.20\ \mathrm{nm}$. According to the uncertainty relation, what is the smallest possible momentum spread $\sigma_pc$ (in eV)? $\hbar c=197\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}$.
question_uz: Elektron to'lqin paketining kengligi $\sigma_x=0.20\ \mathrm{nm}$. Noaniqlik munosabatiga ko'ra impuls tarqoqligining eng kichik qiymati $\sigma_pc$ qancha (eV da)? $\hbar c=197\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}$.
question_ru: Ширина волнового пакета электрона $\sigma_x=0.20\ \mathrm{nm}$. Каково наименьшее значение разброса импульса $\sigma_pc$ (в эВ) по соотношению неопределённостей? $\hbar c=197\ \mathrm{eV\cdot nm}$.
explanation_200:
To'g'ri: E. σp ≥ ħ/(2σx): σpc ≥ 197/(2·0.20) ≈ 493 eV (tenglik Gauss paketida).
Asos: σx·σk ≥ 1/2.

uz: Eng kichik qiymat — Gauss paketi: $$\sigma_pc=\frac{\hbar c}{2\sigma_x}=\frac{197}{0.40}\approx493\ \mathrm{eV}$$
en: The minimum is reached by a Gaussian packet: $$\sigma_pc=\frac{\hbar c}{2\sigma_x}=\frac{197}{0.40}\approx493\ \mathrm{eV}$$

source: Kahn & Anderson, «Conquering the Physics GRE», 5.2 g'oyasi asosida; sharti o'zgartirilgan
